summary: Erayak Power Solution Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting. The meeting proposes a share capital reduction (par value from $0.22 to $0.00001), subdivision of authorized but unissued shares, and cancellation of excess authorized shares, all to reorganize share capital. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting notice for a structural capital reorganization, not a special situation event.
